meaning: Anonymised unique speaker identifier per registered contributor
research_use: Speaker-level grouping; counting unique speakers per accent; independence check between datasets
risk_limitation: Not a persistent real identity; hash may differ across versions; re-identification not possible

meaning: Relative path to MP3 audio file within the archive
research_use: Audio file retrieval; subset manifest creation
risk_limitation: Requires full archive download; no standalone audio retrieval

meaning: Exact orthographic text displayed to the speaker during recording
unique_count_est: Multiple speakers may read same sentence; ~50000+ unique sentences
research_use: WER evaluation reference text; transcript quality analysis
risk_limitation: Duplicate sentences across speakers are normal; does not affect independence

meaning: Count of community listeners who confirmed audio matches transcript
research_use: Quality threshold gating; filter by up_votes >= 2 for validated clips
risk_limitation: Low up_vote counts may indicate marginal quality clips; validated.tsv already applies threshold

meaning: Count of community listeners who said audio does NOT match transcript
research_use: Additional quality filter; reject clips where down_votes > up_votes
risk_limitation: All clips in validated.tsv already pass the majority-vote filter

research_use: Demographic stratification; not required for Stage 5
risk_limitation: Optional field; substantial missingness; do not use as proxy for accent

meaning: Self-reported gender (updated in later versions to include broader categories)
research_use: Demographic stratification; not required for Stage 5
risk_limitation: Optional; missingness; gender categories vary by version

meaning: Self-reported accent or English variety label
unique_count_est: 16 enumerated categories in v11; unlimited in v12+
research_use: PRIMARY GROUP VARIABLE for Stage 5 evaluation group definition
risk_limitation: Largest research risk: self-reported (not L1 verified); ~50% missing; free-text in v12+; must use enumerated version (v11)

research_use: Language filtering; does not imply accent or speaker origin
risk_limitation: Must NOT be used as an accent proxy

meaning: Optional subset identifier for specialised collection campaigns
research_use: Subset membership if special campaign data is relevant
risk_limitation: Usually empty; ignore if not relevant to study design
